primitives.name: Ten-Second Trust Hierarchy
primitives.verbatim_quote: Your job is to make the product feel inevitable: the clearest, most premium, most trustworthy NFL intelligence experience on the internet.
primitives.assumptions: User attention spans follow an exponential decay function with a characteristic time constant of 10 seconds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When the UX fails to communicate trust within 10 seconds, user engagement collapses exponentially.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's conformal prediction intervals, where the 10-second layer acts as a calibration window for probabilistic guarantees.

primitives.breakdown_regime: When first-party charting is unavailable, the data transitions into a high-variance, low-trust regime.

primitives.name: Discovery Query Efficiency
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Implemented foundation - 546 seeded sources, 800 candidate records, 500,000 candidate capacity, 2,200 discovery queries, and 800 metric definitions.
primitives.assumptions: Each query incurs a computational overhead that scales linearly with the number of candidate metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When query volume exceeds 2,200, the system experiences saturation and diminishing returns.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's state-transition models, where discovery queries represent actions that transition the system between data-confidence states.
